gloss: extension and remodeling; renovation and expansion

definitions.gloss: extension and remodeling; renovation and expansion (of a building)
definitions.explanation: The combined processes of adding to and remodeling an existing building. Covers both making the building larger (extension) and modifying its existing structure (remodeling).

examples.japanese: ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{増改築|ぞうかいちく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We carry out renovation and expansion of our house.

examples.japanese: {増改築|ぞうかいちく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: A building permit is required for renovation and expansion.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{二階|にかい}→二階：27513_nikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{増改築|ぞうかいちく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: Since we had more children, we decided to extend and remodel the second floor to add rooms.

notes:
A compound of three characters: {増|ぞう} (increase, add) + {改|かい} (modify, reform) + ⟦{築|ちく}→築：29014_chiku⟧ (build, construct). Covers the full range of building modifications — from adding new rooms or floors to renovating existing spaces. Common in real estate, construction, and housing contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {増改築|ぞうかいちく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to carry out renovation and expansion
- {増改築|ぞうかいちく}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧: renovation/expansion construction work
- {増改築|ぞうかいちく}⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧: renovation/expansion costs
- {増改築|ぞうかいちく}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: no renovation/expansion allowed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦リフォーム→リフォーム：08821_rifoomu⟧: remodeling, renovation — the popular loanword for home renovation; does not necessarily include expansion
- ⟦{改築|かいちく}→改築：06224_kaichiku⟧: remodeling — modifying an existing structure without necessarily adding to it
- ⟦{増築|ぞうちく}→増築：06568_zouchiku⟧: extension — adding new space to an existing building
- ⟦リノベーション→リノベーション：11211_rinobeeshon⟧: renovation — a loanword that implies more extensive modernization than ⟦リフォーム→リフォーム：08821_rifoomu⟧
